limits: Winner/runner-up selected from all causally available keys, including chat-prefix and current query. Keys in chat prefix retained; no body-only filtering. Winning selection guarantees positive full margin, so positive alignment is partly selection-conditioned. Individual pair contributions can be negative and cancel. Amplitude is available score strength, not realized attention effect or downstream importance. Pool weighted maps can be dominated by a few high-amplitude heads; per-head maps independently normalized. Observational density, not a causal decomposition or proof of range selection. Main angle axes linear; density colors logarithmic; no smoothing.
prose_winner_filter: Condition on original native winner being in passage body; do not rerank candidates. Original runner-up retained.
